# Matthias Függer

> Research Director, CNRS. My current focus is the systematic engineering of robust microbial systems, with applications in bioproduction, diagnosis, and medical treatment. This includes distributed computation in bacterial systems, particularly communication and coordination between cells. My approach combines experiments, modeling, numerical simulation, AI, and mathematical analysis.

This is the personal academic website of Matthias Függer. The files below
are generated from the visible homepage and its source bibliography.
Publication status and author order are preserved; accepted papers may be
listed before publication.

## Profile
- [Homepage](https://mfuegger.github.io/): Research, affiliations, software, teaching, and contact.
- [Profile in Markdown](https://mfuegger.github.io/profile.md): Full readable homepage content.
- [Structured profile](https://mfuegger.github.io/profile.json): Complete profile, research, teaching, contact, and Schema.org Person data.

## Publications
- [Full publication list](https://mfuegger.github.io/publications.html): All papers, by year.
- [Publications in JSON](https://mfuegger.github.io/publications.json): Titles, authors, years, venues, status, links, and source BibTeX.
- [BibTeX bibliography](https://mfuegger.github.io/publications.bib): Authoritative source entries.
- [Last bibliography source check](https://mfuegger.github.io/bibliography-status.json): Check date and source checksum.
